title: Process Watch
summary: Identify and stop one harmless lab process.
description: A process is a running program with a process ID (PID). A synthetic heartbeat process is created just for this challenge. Identify it using process inspection, terminate that process, and verify it stopped. Only processes inside this disposable container are in scope.

workspace_seed.process-notes.txt: A harmless `sleep` process is started automatically for this mission.

offline_hints.title: Think about the concept
offline_hints.content: A process can keep running even if the terminal command that started it has finished.

offline_hints.title: Investigate this area
offline_hints.content: Inspect `.heartbeat.pid`, then compare that PID with `ps` output and use `kill -0` as a non-destructive liveness check.

offline_hints.title: Guided route
offline_hints.content: The PID is saved in `/workspace/.heartbeat.pid`. Use `kill "$(cat .heartbeat.pid)"`, then check `kill -0` for that PID and confirm it is no longer running. Do not kill unrelated PIDs.

completion_explanation: You completed Process Watch. Review the evidence, compare the observed result with the expected state, and explain why it matters in a real defensive workflow.

network_requirements.description: No network interface is required for this mission.
